headline: GE Aerospace (GE) Just Beat and Dropped Again — Is the Third Straight Selloff Any Different This Time?
summary: GE Aerospace (NYSE:GE) has acquired an odd habit of beating earnings and then watching the stock sink. The pattern continued with the company’s Q2 2026 report on July 16, with shares falling nearly 5% in early trading the next day, mirroring the reaction to the previous two earnings reports, despite solid figures each time.
